local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:ItemData/Data')
local Shared = require( "Module:UnitData" )

function toNil(thing)
	if thing==nil or thing=='' then return nil else return thing end
end


function p.getItem(f)
	local name = f.args["item"]
	if not toNil(name) then return 'name' end
	
	if toNil(data[2][name]) then itemName = data[2][name]
	elseif toNil(data[1][name]["name"]) then
	gamename = data[1][name]["name"]
	itemName = data[2][gamename]
	end
	return p.Main(itemName)
end




function p.Main(iName)
	local Item = type(iName)=='table' and iName or p.getIcon(iName)
	local cIndex={
		["Boosts"]='drawBoost',
		['Stars']='drawStas',
		['XP Food']='drawXPFood',
		['Materials']='drawMaterial',
		['NoIcon']='drawNoIcon',
	} --если класс не совпадает, использует функцию drawIcon
 --   setmetatable(cIndex, {__index = function () return 'drawIcon' end})
	if not toNil(Item.item_group) then
		return p['drawIcon'](Item)
	end
	return p[cIndex[Item.item_group] or 'drawIcon'](Item)
end


function callCustomTooltip(targetClass, ...) --возвращает тултип запрошенного класса.
	return drawIcon( ... )
		:addClass( targetClass )
		:attr('data-param', select( 1 , ... )['name'] )
end

function p.drawBoost(...) return tostring(drawBoost(...)) end
function drawBoost(...)
	return callCustomTooltip('boost-tooltip', ...)
end

function p.drawStas(...) return tostring(drawStas(...)) end
function drawStas(...)
	return callCustomTooltip('stas-tooltip', ...)
end

function p.drawXPFood(...) return tostring(drawXPFood(...)) end
function drawXPFood(...)
	return callCustomTooltip('XPFood-tooltip', ...)
end

function p.drawMaterial(...) return tostring(drawMaterial(...)) end
function drawMaterial(...)
	return callCustomTooltip('material-tooltip', ...)
end





function p.getIcon(iName)
	local Item = {}

	if type(data[2][iName])=='table' then
		copy(data[2][iName])
	end
	Item.name = Item.name or iName
	return Item
end







function p.drawIcon(...) return tostring(drawIcon(...)) end
function drawIcon(item)
	Item = item
	if Item.item_group == "Materials" then 
		Link = "Items#Materials"
		return draftIcon(Item, Link):wikitext(' ')
					:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
					:wikitext('[['.. Link  ..'|'.. Item.name ..']]'):done()
	elseif Item.item_group == "Evolution" then 
		Link = "Evolution"
		return draftIcon(Item, Link):wikitext(' ')
					:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
					:wikitext('[['.. Link  ..'|'.. Item.name ..']]'):done()
	elseif Item.item_group == "XP Food" then 
		Link = "Items#XP_Food"
		return draftIcon(Item, Link):wikitext(' ')
					:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
					:wikitext('[['.. Link  ..'|'.. Item.name ..']]'):done()
	elseif Item.item_group == "Boosts" then 
		Link = "Items#Boosts"
		return draftIcon(Item, Link):wikitext(' ')
					:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
					:wikitext('[['.. Link  ..'|'.. Item.name ..']]'):done()
	elseif Item.item_group == "Stars" then 
		Link = "Items#Materials"
		return draftIcon(Item, Link):wikitext(' ')
					:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
					:wikitext('[['.. Link  ..'|'.. Item.name ..']]'):done()
	else return draftIcon(Item):wikitext(' '.. Item.name):attr('class','dottedText') end  
end


function p.draftIcon(...)	return tostring(draftIcon(...)) end
function draftIcon(Item, Link)
	return mw.html.create('span')
		:wikitext('[[File:'.. Item.name ..'.png|x'.. 24 ..'px|link='.. (Item.Link or '') ..'|'.. (Item.name or '') ..']]')
end





return p
